name: TaskPanes
description: A collection of TaskPane objects that contains commonly performed tasks in Microsoft Word.
remarks: Use the TaskPanes property to return the TaskPanes collection. Use the Item method with a WdTaskPanes constant to refer to a specific task pane. The example below displays the formatting task pane.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of task panes in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TaskPanes object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns the specified task pane as a TaskPane object.
